Short title and commencement

PAKISTAN PENAL CODE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
PAKISTAN PENAL CODE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
ACT II OF 1992
An Act furtehr to
amend the Pakistan Penal Code.
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 4th March, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 2nd
March, 1992 and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(l) This Act may be called the Pakistan Penal Code
(Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 123-A, Act XLV of 1860

[Gazette of Pakistan,

The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 2nd
March, 1992 and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 123-A,
Act XLV of 1860----In the Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860),
hereinafter called the Penal Code, in section 123-A;
(a) after the word `safety', the
words `or ideology' shall be inserted; and
(b) after the word and comma
`representation', the words `abuse Pakistan or' shall be inserted.
